name: DE-JA 2
source:
De-Ja 2 starts after two years from events of the previous game. The young researcher and archeologist Hatsushiba Ryuusuke has solved the mystery of the ancient staff and revealed machinations of the Japanese Archeological Society's director.
Although he is famous now, Ryuusuke continiues his researches, and soon enough an old archeologist, Jinguuji, contacts him and asks his assistance in revealing the secrets of Palau's shrine. Ryuusuke, accompanied by Jinguuji's beautiful daughter, Himiko, is going to find the truth which is said to be able to turn the Universe from inside out...
translation:
《DE-JA 2》的故事发生在前作事件两年后。年轻研究员兼考古学家初芝龙介已经解开古代手杖之谜，也揭露了日本考古学会会长的阴谋。
虽然如今已经成名，龙介仍在继续研究。不久，一名叫神宫寺的老考古学家与他取得联系，请求他协助揭开帕劳神殿的秘密。龙介与神宫寺美丽的女儿卑弥呼一同踏上旅程，准备查明那个据说足以令整个宇宙内外翻转的真相…
